scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm test -w backend && npm test -w frontend
scripts.test:coverage: npm test -w backend -- --coverage && npm test -w frontend -- --coverage
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build -w frontend && npx cap sync
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
